quoted_Super_effect_timing:
The FAQ quotes these Super effect timing clauses; they do not make a flare apply automatically in later encounters. Follow the full card for its other conditions and legal play.

| Original Super flare | Quoted effect timing |
|---|---|
| Kamikaze, Machine, Masochist | During each of **your own Regroup phases** |
| Miser | At the start of each of **your encounters** |
| Cudgel | Whenever you **use your power** |

These are effect timing clauses, not a reconstruction of an earlier permitted faceup-placement window (FAQ pp12,16–18).

Fido_note.old: **FAQ p13:** Take only an actual encounter card played as such, not an encounter card merely discarded by Plague, Fodder or Reserve. Clone keeps before discarding; Fido competes with Filch using ordinary timing.
Fido_note.new: **FAQ p13; FAQ p4:** Take only an actual encounter card played as such, not an encounter card merely discarded by Plague, Fodder or Reserve. Clone keeps before discarding; Fido competes with Filch using ordinary timing. For the Fido flare effect described by the FAQ, the forced discard-pile draw takes its top card.

primary_sources: 2018 FAQ p4 280–287 Fido flare described without side identification
